classification: The 0.4.19 core OS, direct microSD mount, catalog, audio, touch, display, and bounded recovery lifecycle are stable. corrective_action: Do not add unbounded boot retries or flash this candidate again. Inspect the pinned hub driver's enumeration-failure path and the actual hub/controller descriptors, then either add a narrowly bounded downstream-port power/reset re-enumeration hook above the pinned component or qualify a direct/full-speed wired controller path. Preserve the stable controller-first OS and keep USB Drive role switching mutually exclusive.
